$comment: Routing and budget policy for relay on the Codex (ChatGPT) harness. Same shape of decisions as config/routing.json, with the three things the Codex harness adds: a speed tier per spawn, per-window stop lines keyed by the window the account actually has (primary / secondary, from account/rateLimits/read), and a reset-credit rule. Priors marked `prior` are to be replaced by `relay calibrate` samples.

budget.$comment: Stop lines by window: `windows` is keyed by position (primary, secondary) for accounts with a short primary window; `weekly` applies to any window of seven days or more whatever its position, so a Pro account (weekly window only, reported as primary) is gated by the weekly lines.

forecast.$comment: Work units are relay's: weight = tierWeight[tier] × riskFactor[risk], read here as relative token volume of a task. tokensPerUnit turns units into total tokens processed (input + cached input + output summed over a thread's turns); tokenMix splits them; the model's credit rates and included-metering weights (config/codex-harness.json → pricing) turn tokens into credits; windowCapacityCredits says how many credits are 100% of a window. Everything under `prior` is replaced by `relay calibrate` samples; the comments say which priors live readings support (evidence/RESULTS.md, harness/FINDINGS.md §9).

prior.$comment: tokensPerUnit is a scale prior (uncalibrated at relay's unit): at this token mix it reproduces the credits per unit the nine scratch runs measured (cheap 0.018–0.026, mid 0.30–0.49, strong 1.48 at published rates / 0.74 metered). tokenMix is the mix real Codex sessions showed on 2026-10-20 → 22 (326 M tokens of gpt-6.1-sol: 2.6% uncached input, 97.1% cached input, 0.3% output; the scratch runs ran 7–30% uncached and 1% output). effortOutputMultiplier stays a prior: the scratch runs produced 0–148 reasoning tokens, too few to see it.

windowCapacityCredits.$comment: published-rate credits (gpt-6.1-sol mix, metered weights) that fill 100% of a window, by plan type as account/rateLimits/read reports it. self_serve_business_prolite: measured (29 integer steps of the weekly window over two windows, Q̂ = 6 176, per-day 6 077–6 679). team: two 5-hour windows (1 → 99% on 208 credits, 1 → 44% on 120) give 212 and 277, their weekly window 1 300 and 1 640 (weak: one machine's rollouts, usage elsewhere invisible); plus and business are assumed equal to team (OpenAI documents Plus and Standard Business with the same per-five-hour estimates). pro: 12 600–18 100 from 4 points (weak). promax: 4 × pro (placeholder). unknown: plus.
